r6-fowler.title: Refactoring pass (Fowler code smells)
r6-fowler.imperative: Run the refactoring / code-smell pass (SKILL.md 'Refactoring pass'). Render a verdict on each Fowler baseline smell (long method, large class, duplicated code, feature envy, data clumps, primitive obsession, long parameter list, shotgun surgery, divergent change, message chains, speculative generality, comments-as-deodorant): flagged / overridden / absent. Smells are judgment calls, ALWAYS subordinate to the repo's documented standards — an override needs a logged standard + reason. Record the pass to .agent-work/w2-basis/FOWLER_PASS.json (from templates/FOWLER_PASS.template.json), run scripts/verify_fowler_pass.py .agent-work/w2-basis/FOWLER_PASS.json (it refuses a skipped smell or an unlogged override), then record pass/fail with a finding. This item's postcondition command resolves the record path from w2-basis alone -- the same substitution you already make everywhere else in this survey (line 2) -- so no separate placeholder to fill and no way to leave it stale. REPAIR PATH -- only if the record path ever needs to move off that fixed convention, correct it through the engine with `spine_amend`, whose `delta` carries the single op `retext-check` on this item's c1, never by hand-editing this survey. There, `authority` is the dispatching Commander named in your reviewer handoff (never a string you invent), and `reason` is why the path changed. Do NOT silently skip this item.
